George William Russell, The National Being.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/george-william-russell/the-national-being

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- George William Russell, the author and the annotator, died 1935.

First publication of the text used: 1916 (SE colophon: 'The National Being was published in 1916 by George William Russell.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1916, before 1931, so it is in the United States public domain. Standard Ebooks also states this in its rights statement below.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa, and each has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last to die, George William Russell, died 1935, so the text is public domain in each of these countries from 1 January 2006.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
